mapper.insert: insert into kg_entities ( id, name, entity_type, source_book, wing, room, description, valid_from_months, valid_to_months, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{entity.id, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{entity.name}, #{entity.entityType}, #{entity.sourceBook}, #{entity.wing}, #{entity.room}, #{entity.description}, #{entity.validFromMonths}, #{entity.validToMonths}, #{entity.createdAt}, #{entity.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, name, entity_type, source_book, wing, room, description, valid_from_months, valid_to_months, created_at, updated_at from kg_entities where id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}

select id, name, entity_type, source_book, wing, room, description, valid_from_months, valid_to_months, created_at, updated_at from kg_entities where name ilike #{searchPattern} order by similarity(name, #{query}) desc, name
select id, name, entity_type, source_book, wing, room, description, valid_from_months, valid_to_months, created_at, updated_at from kg_entities where wing = #{wing} and room = #{room} order by name
mapper.update: update kg_entities set name = #{entity.name}, entity_type = #{entity.entityType}, source_book = #{entity.sourceBook}, wing = #{entity.wing}, room = #{entity.room}, description = #{entity.description}, valid_from_months = #{entity.validFromMonths}, valid_to_months = #{entity.validToMonths}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{entity.id, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
